name: app-lime-design-goals-card-grid-slide
title: Lime Design Goals Card Grid
whatItIs: A white slide, Design Goals, with a big title and six pale cards each showing a small UI fragment (tab bar, AI card, search form, place card, trip stack, flight ticket) with a title and description below.
whatItMeans: Each principle is paired with a tiny real UI piece, so goals feel concrete, and lime and dark green keep it fresh.
techniques: Six-card grid pairing UI fragments with captions
Numbered pill tag beside the title
Lime highlight as the only bright colour
Consistent card size and caption format
Dark green for strong UI elements

vocabulary.definition: A cropped piece of interface used as illustration.
A card stating one design objective with a visual.
A bold title and a grey description under an image.
